build_scope: private helper.cpp full translation unit compiled twice, linked with the same existing CMake static libraries; not clean full-project builds

platforms.macOS: full helper TU compile/link and real helper runtime
platforms.Linux: source inspection only, STL/mutex/catalog APIs unchanged
platforms.Windows: source inspection only, no platform API or preprocessor additions; no native compile/link/runtime

locking: search mutex acquired then catalog Find; same search-to-catalog order used by IngestCatalogIntoSearch. Mutation methods return/release catalog mutex before invoking cleanup. No reverse lock nesting added. Seeded recheck prevents deleting an observation if a reseed already completed. No concurrent RPC stress claimed.
scope_limits: explicit unhost/unseed/remove only; remote observations remain historical, no map cap/TTL, no guarantee for unrelated catalog eviction paths
preservation_test: exact cleanup function extracted unchanged, narrow test adapters for catalog/id/observation types; native compile -std=c++20 -Wall -Wextra -Werror and execution passed, preserving remote-labelled entries/empty-map erasure/noop/seeded recheck. Not real peer ingestion.
